Renee: quick follow-up from the postmortem. we need concrete owners + a tiny handoff template so stewards can act immediately. proposal: two remediation cohorts (cache+metrics, routing+alerts) with one steward each and a single reviewer.

Oli: +1. grouping should cut down repeated context handoffs. can we list tickets and owners?

Renee: Draft tickets: RW-9401 (ttl-consistency-detector), RW-9402 (kv-metrics-coverage), RW-9403 (fallback-routing-timeouts), RW-9404 (alert-dedupe). i'll create parent RW-9500 and add checklist once owners confirm.

Priya: i'll steward RW-9401/9402 (cache/metrics). i'll add ACs and a rollback plan.

Dan: i'll take RW-9403 (routing) and coordinate infra review. tagging @Oli for review.

Support-Triage: RW-9404 created and assigned to Support-Triage for initial triage: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-9404

pager-bot: Follow-up group created and linked to parent RW-9500. Next checkpoint scheduled in 5 business days.

Renee: quick RACI draft:
```
Ticket    Responsible   Accountable   Consulted      Informed
RW-9401   Priya         Renee         Observability  Eng+Support
RW-9402   Priya         Renee         Metrics team   Eng+Support
RW-9403   Dan           Oli           Infra          Eng+Support
RW-9404   Support-Triage Renee         Support        Eng+Support
```

Priya: handoff checklist (short) i'm putting into RW-9500: 1) Jira with ACs + rollback, 2) 2-sentence incident excerpt, 3) runbook link + failing logs, 4) smoke commands, 5) two pairing slots.

Oli: for RW-9403 i'll review and request a small canary (0.5% traffic) before full rollout. also suggest adding a regression test to CI to catch TTL+retry interplay.

Renee: action items summary:
- Priya: ACs + runbook links for RW-9401/RW-9402 (due EOD tomorrow)
- Dan: routing canary plan + infra review request for RW-9403 (48h)
- Support-Triage: triage notes for RW-9404 and steward recommendation (72h)
- Renee: create RW-9500 parent, post RACI, schedule weekly 20m sync

Dan: booked pairing with Oli Thu 10:00PT. will post canary plan before then.

Priya: ACs up and linked to RW-9500. added a short repro and expected results.

Support-Triage: RW-9404 triage notes posted. recommending Support-Eng steward after initial investigation.

pager-bot: Checkpoint: cohort tickets RW-9401..9404 added to sprint board. Next sync in 5 business days.
